criteria.borderline: Include requirements/architecture/testing/review/security/operations only when human work or lifecycle evidence is relevant. Technical quality evidence may support assurance/readiness/rework/risk but cannot validate human workload.

exclusion.E1: non-software domain without transferable SE construct
exclusion.E10: building AI/ML products rather than AI assistance in software delivery
exclusion.E2: code-generation benchmark only, without human/process/delivery implication
exclusion.E4: opinion/marketing/news without traceable evidence or construct
exclusion.E8: claimed empirical result has no transparent method
exclusion.E9: traditional Story-Point prediction only, without evidence that AI changes work or estimation validity

inclusion.I1: professional or realistically simulated software engineering/development/delivery
inclusion.I2: generative AI, LLM assistant, or agentic coding system is material
inclusion.I3: measures, models, or substantively analyzes human work, planning, readiness, flow, oversight, or quality consequences
inclusion.I4: inspectable method, framework definition, dataset, or evidence trail
inclusion.I6: within date window or intentionally foundational

security_boundary: Checksum-bound static text only; no network, Git/history, credentials, PDF execution, or private systems.
